name: HeliosCLI
observation_method: Sequential connected-GitHub inventory and bounded default-history/source reads; selected fields transcribed, not a raw API export.
sampled_commit_scope: Latest default-history item returned at this repository read; not all branches or local state and not an atomic end-of-audit head.
movement: Recent commits expand root Dependabot coverage and update a Mergify configuration field.
concerns: The inherited atlas flags a root workspace versus real vendored agent executable distinction. Revalidate rather than assuming fixed or broken.

next_actions.title: Identify the shipped binary
next_actions.work: Map real executable/build root and owned upstream delta; compare the installed version with the claimed candidate.
next_actions.acceptance: A clean install launches the intended fork, not a harness-only package or upstream binary.

next_actions.title: Complete a controlled coding task
next_actions.work: Read permitted source, change one feature, run meaningful tests, deny prohibited writes, interrupt and resume.
next_actions.acceptance: Task outcome and side effects are correct; source/profile/artifact and failure receipts attached.

next_actions.title: Close update and upstream contracts
next_actions.work: Update the fork from a supported installed version and test preserved sessions/settings and rollback; compare with upstream on the same task.
next_actions.acceptance: Upgrade does not overwrite unrelated data; owned value is separated from inherited features.

ecosystem_contract: Reuse core contracts and utilities from actual authoritative owners; do not duplicate provider/session policy across the coding-client family.
parent_acceptance: A real installed coding agent completes and recovers a useful task through its owned distribution channel.
scope_missing: actual chat receipts and read acknowledgement
